name: Cask 'n' Anvil
summary: The Cask 'n' Anvil is a quiet, unnamed tavern building situated in the bustling heart of the Great Forge in Ironforge. Tucked between local shops, it stands as an open gathering hall featuring tables and hearths without a permanent innkeeper or barkeep on staff.

sections.title: A Respite in the Forge
sections.body: Positioned between the Thistlefuzz Arcanery and the Ironforge Physician, the Cask 'n' Anvil offers a momentary escape from the deafening clatter of the Great Forge. While most taverns in Ironforge bustle with rowdy patrons and busy barkeeps, this spacious hall remains unstaffed, leaving its tables, chairs, and warm hearth open to weary travelers and wandering smiths looking for a quiet bench to sit upon.

faq.q: Where is the Cask 'n' Anvil located?
faq.answer: You can find this establishment along the outer ring of the Great Forge in Ironforge, situated directly between the Thistlefuzz Arcanery and the Ironforge Physician.
Currently, no barkeep or innkeeper maintains the tavern. The building stands open to the public, functioning primarily as an empty gathering place with tables and seating.

faq.q: Can I set my hearthstone here?
faq.answer: No. Because there is no active innkeeper running the counter, you cannot bind your hearthstone or purchase food and drink inside this building.

angles.text: For dwarves working long hours beside the fires of the Great Forge, this open hall offers an accessible, quiet place to sit down and rest weary legs away from the anvil.
